prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1165; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident and my injuries, if that's okay.
Q: That works. Can you tell me where you were driving when the collision happened?
A: I was on a main road in Sugar Land, heading toward a shopping center. Traffic had slowed down ahead of me, so I was already stopped at a light.
Q: And what happened next?
A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The other car had hit me while I was stopped.
Q: Did you get out of your vehicle and speak with the other driver?
A: Yes, we exchanged information. He said he looked down at his phone for a second and didn't see the stopped traffic in time.
Q: Were there any police or emergency responders at the scene?
A: An officer came out and took a report. I think the paramedics checked on me too, but I didn't go in an ambulance.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: I went to urgent care the same day. They told me I had a neck and back strain. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week since then.
Q: How would you describe your pain right now?
A: My neck is stiff, especially when I turn to check my blind spot. My lower back aches after I sit for more than about thirty minutes, and I've had trouble sleeping through the night.
Q: Have you missed any work or daily activities because of the injuries?
A: I've had to leave early a couple of times because sitting at my desk is uncomfortable. I've also cut back on yard work and lifting groceries.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm following my doctor's plan and I want to get back to normal as soon as I can.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
